notes.ndsLabel: The approximately 25 x 30 mm label recess and 3.3 mm keyed lower corner restore the characteristic DS Game Card face without changing its 33 x 35 mm insertion envelope.
notes.ndsSeating: The installed Slot-1 edge rests 0.8 mm proud of the shell mouth, matching the modeled push-to-eject travel so the press brings the card flush before spring release. This is an interaction calibration rather than a published Nintendo tolerance.
notes.gbaEnvelope: The modeled 57 x 34 x 8 mm insertion body reconciles an approximately 57 x 35 x 8 mm body measurement with a separate 60 x 34 x 9 mm full-envelope measurement. The finger grip supplies the 60 mm maximum width and 9 mm maximum thickness.
notes.gbaSeating: A standard GBA Game Pak remains approximately 10 mm proud of the shallower DS Lite Slot-2 when fully inserted.
notes.slotOpenings: Nintendo does not publish DS Lite shell aperture tolerances. Each modeled opening is therefore the measured insertion body plus 0.2 mm clearance per side in width and thickness.
notes.animation: Ejection distances move each Game Pak 4 mm clear of its slot; the 0.8 mm Slot-1 push and 2 mm visual cavity depth are authored interaction values rather than published Nintendo measurements.
